resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Bengali source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Bengali pass identified 25 remaining technical wording, terminology, and unit-formatting defects across TCR, trigonometry, thermal concepts, heat flux, and SI units; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Bengali human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The watt conversion used the wrong Bengali prefix for milliwatts.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the protected engineering form 1 W = 1,000 mW.

findings.summary: The TCR description used an awkward verb for describing resistance change.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural Bengali technical wording.

findings.summary: The TCR summary used প্রতিরোধ ক্ষমতা, which can mean resistance capacity rather than resistance.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the precise Bengali term for resistance.

findings.summary: The near-zero TCR bullet used an inconsistent transliteration and awkward construction.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with consistent TCR and রোধ terminology.

findings.summary: The coefficient-sign bullet was grammatically incomplete.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as a complete Bengali instruction while preserving the sign warning.

findings.summary: The worked example title used an unnatural genitive phrase.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise title উত্তপ্ত রোধ.

findings.summary: The TCR current formula omitted spacing around division.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Changed it to I = V / R.

findings.summary: The power paragraph mixed resistance capacity with electrical power terminology.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to distinguish রোধ from বৈদ্যুতিক ক্ষমতা.

findings.summary: The trigonometry title translated sides as দিক rather than the geometric term বাহু.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Changed it to অজানা বাহু ও কোণ নির্ণয়.

findings.summary: The right-triangle setup used an unnatural verb for forming an angle.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as a natural statement that a 10 cm hypotenuse forms a 30° angle.

findings.summary: The example conclusion used an awkward literal phrase for an inverse trigonometric function.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Changed it to বিপরীতমুখী ত্রিকোণমিতিক ফাংশন.

findings.summary: The waveform instruction referred to keeping sine and quadrant rather than signs and quadrant.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity example title retained the literal কাজের উদাহরণ.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer Bengali title সমাধানসহ উদাহরণ.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity setup localized kg inconsistently and used less natural wording for water.
evidence: The previous Bengali presentation contained the wording or notation described above.
